result.title: Controlling Temporal Pseudo-Label Marginals for Stable Online Test-Time Adaptation
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages. Code: https://github.com/r-isr/SCALAR
result.summary: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) methods update models online using a stream of unlabeled data to overcome distribution shifts encountered at test time. However, CTTA is often unstable, as it can reinforce biases in early predictions and increasingly predict only a few classes, resulting in drift or even collapse. In this paper, we identify narrowing pseudo-label class usage as an indicator of CTTA instability and quantify this behavior. Most existing methods have attempted to address this issue by either selecting reliable adaptation samples or re-weighting the loss to encourage diverse pseudo-labels, but they do not explicitly enforce a class marginal over a temporal window. Instead, we propose Sinkhorn Class-Marginal Regularization (SCALAR), a simple plug-and-play module that controls the pseudo-label distribution over a short temporal window. SCALAR works by maintaining recent predictions in a buffer, balancing their class distribution via the Sinkhorn algorithm to match a specified target distribution, and using the balanced soft targets for adaptation. Without changing the model architecture, SCALAR maintains the per-step runtime and increases the peak allocated GPU memory by only 10 MB on ImageNet-C. Our method is particularly effective on skewed, non-stationary data with severe distribution shifts, where SCALAR significantly alleviates drift and collapse when combined with existing stabilization methods based on entropy or diversity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 CTTA 中伪标签类别使用面收窄量化为不稳定指标，并提出即插即用的 SCALAR 模块：缓存近期预测，用 Sinkhorn 在短时间窗内平衡类别边际以对齐给定目标分布，再用平衡后的软目标更新模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用分布收窄诊断漂移／坍缩」与「在时间窗上施加 Sinkhorn 目标边际约束」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态或推理轨迹的模式坍缩监测与正则化，但任务和表示层面与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
